requested.description: Ask the human a question. Always surfaced as a request, never inferred approval.

prompt.description: The question or prompt for the human.

response_shape.description: Expected answer shape, e.g. text, choice, approval. Free-form label agreed by both agents.

responded.description: Answer a human request. Requires a local human-approval record; approval is never taken from a sender assertion.

request_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the human.requested event.

description: Human-in-the-loop payloads: human.requested, human.responded. The envelope's protected event_type selects the variant.
title: Human payloads
